summary: Frontend-only verification of two fixes on artirdim.com: (1) Story upload image preview visibility, (2) auction status badge visibility on home/browse and badge consistency on the public profile showcase. Plus quick regression on auction detail countdown and PLANLI page. ALL 4 requested checks PASS. Verified compiled assets (public/build/assets/app-DtSW-w3u.js, theme-new.css) are newer than the edited sources, so the fixes are live.

issues: 6 seeded auction images 404: /storage/auctions/a2.jpg, a3.jpg, a4.jpg, a5.jpg, a6.jpg, a8.jpg. Fallback 'Görsel bulunamadı' placeholder renders correctly so no visual break, but console shows 6 x 404 and most cards show placeholders instead of photos.
Stats show '5 İLAN' while the guest showcase renders only 4 cards (draft correctly excluded) — the listing count appears to include the non-public draft, which is inconsistent for guests.

Sidebar 'KALAN' shows 8 gün 23 saat (time-to-end) while the planned box says 'Başlamasına: 1 gün 23 saat' — two different countdowns side by side can confuse; consider hiding/relabelling KALAN for planned auctions.

action_items: Re-seed or fix missing /storage/auctions/a2..a8.jpg image files (6 x 404).
Optional: make profile 'İLAN' count use the same ->public() scope as the showcase for guests.
Optional: for PLANLI auctions, hide or relabel the sidebar KALAN countdown to avoid conflicting with 'Başlamasına'.
critical_code_review_comments: StoryUpload.vue relies on inline :style display overrides to beat the CSS `display:none` on .su-preview/.su-ph. This works but is fragile — prefer removing the display:none from CSS and using v-show, otherwise a future CSS !important will re-break it.
All idx-*-badge classes duplicate position/typography rules; consider a shared .idx-badge base class + colour modifiers to avoid the z-index-style regression happening again on one variant only.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Created a temp 60x60 PNG at /tmp/story_test.png for the file-input test; story was NOT submitted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified results: (1) STORY PREVIEW PASS — modal opens both via UI [data-testid=story-add] and window.openStoryUpload(); after set_input_files on [data-testid=story-file-input], .su-ph computed display goes flex->none and .su-preview none->block with 350x260 box and an with blob: src (naturalWidth 60). (2) HOME badges: 20 visible badges, all z-index:3, computed display block, visibility visible, offsetParent set (AKTİF/PLANLI/BİTTİ). BROWSE /browse/auctions: 12 visible AKTİF badges. PASS. (3) PROFILE /u/seller: exactly 4 showcase cards with correct distinct badges — NAV COUNTDOWN TEST 3 Saat=AKTİF, Antika Masa Saati=AKTİF, PLANLI TEST Ilan=PLANLI, SONA ERMIS TEST Ilan=BİTTİ; draft 'Onay Bekleyen' NOT present for guest. PASS. (4) REGRESSION: /auctions/antika-masa-saati-ve-vazo-seti-MD1c loads, #live-timer='5 gün 23 saat' (day granularity so no visible tick in 3s); /auctions/nav-3h-DUp1C #live-timer ticked '2 saat 42 dk' -> '2 saat 41 dk' confirming the ticker runs. /auctions/planned-HfQfot shows the planned box ('Planlı — henüz başlamadı', start date, 'Başlamasına') and 0 bid-form elements. LiveKit streaming remains untested/BLOCKED (no keys).
rca_of_the_issue: Both original defects were CSS-specificity/stacking issues: .su-preview had a hard `display:none` in CSS that overrode Vue's v-show (now beaten by an inline :style binding), and the idx-* badge classes were absolutely positioned without z-index so the card image/overlay painted above them (now z-index:3). Both fixes are present in source and in the freshly built Vite bundle, and confirmed live in the browser.
